If a live channel has shown no picture by this time, DeodatoTV stops trying and tells you, instead of leaving a black screen while it works through every player it has. Never keeps trying, which can take well over a minute on a channel your provider has removed. Waits your provider asks for are not counted.
Your TMDB API key and self-hosted server address will be deleted from this device, and DeodatoTV will go back to the built-in shared service with its daily share.

The built-in service is shared by everyone using DeodatoTV. If any minute, hourly or daily allowance is used up, TMDB details pause until that window resets; playlist information keeps working. Your own key or Worker removes this allowance.
DeodatoTV Worker · no setup
Leave both blank for DeodatoTV’s shared Worker. A custom Worker URL takes priority over a direct API key. Account sessions remain profile-specific.

On a phone, tablet or computer on the same Wi-Fi, scan the QR (or open the URL), enter this PIN, choose your DeodatoTV backup file and tap Send to TV. You then pick what to restore here.
Surround — send Dolby/DTS to a real 5.1/7.1 receiver. If it goes silent or stutters, DeodatoTV still falls back to stereo and tells you.
DeodatoTV is a player \u2014 bring your own Xtream, M3U, or Stalker source.
DeodatoTV is a media player only. It includes no channels, playlists, or content. You are responsible for adding your own legally accessible Xtream, M3U, or Stalker sources.
